description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller class 'ShippingOptionsController' that handles HTTP requests related to managing shipping options in an e-commerce admin panel. It includes methods for displaying current shipping configuration and saving updates, interacting with services and models associated with shipping configuration.

classes.name: ShippingOptionsController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for managing shipping options in the admin interface. Handles displaying current shipping config and saving updates.

methods.name: displayShippingOptions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the shipping options page, retrieving the shipping configuration and preparing model attributes.

methods.name: saveShippingOptions
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save shipping configuration updates, including validation and error handling.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets up the menu context for the view, marking active pages and current menu item.
